title: fix(packages): POST /packages/:id/revert reverts a Studio-authored package instead of answering 404
body:
Fixes #22090
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## Summary

`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/revert` answered `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND "No metadata items found for package '…'"` for a Studio-authored package that held published items and a pending draft, and the draft stayed. The door asked only the metadata service, whose in-memory registry never holds a Studio package's stored rows.

The door now asks the protocol first. `revertStoredPackage` reads the package's `sys_metadata` rows through the predicate `listDrafts` already used, refuses a never-published package with the declared `409`, and otherwise removes the drafts through the per-draft step `discardPackageDrafts` takes. A package with no stored row is answered by the metadata service's `revertPackage`, exactly as before.

## Where it landed, and why not in `metadata-manager.ts`

The dispatch expected the fix in `MetadataManager.revertPackage` (`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts:2062`). Measurement put the producer elsewhere:

- `@objectstack/metadata` cannot reach the stored rows. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` depends on it, not the other way round. On a real boot the manager has no `sys_metadata` loader either: `setDataEngine` / `setDatabaseDriver` (`metadata-manager.ts:605`, `:635`) have no caller in the tree, and the repository the plugin attaches is a `FileSystemRepository` (`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts:538`).
- The stored rows, the package-scoped read and the draft discard all live in `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`. So the seam is a protocol verb, and the door in `@objectstack/runtime` composes the two services.

`metadata-manager.ts` is unchanged.

## Mechanism (measured)

- **H1: confirmed.** On `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` at base `b04a5295f7`, the following answered `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND "No metadata items found for package 'com.example.repairs'"`, and `GET /meta/_drafts?packageId=com.example.repairs` still listed the draft. The steps:
  - `POST /packages` creates `com.example.repairs`;
  - `PUT /meta/object/repairs_ticket?package=com.example.repairs&mode=draft` saves an object;
  - `POST /packages/com.example.repairs/publish-drafts` publishes it (`outcome: published`);
  - a second draft save edits it;
  - `POST /packages/com.example.repairs/revert` returns the 404.

  The same package, published and with no draft, also answered 404. Call chain at base:
  - `dispatcher-plugin.ts:1380` mounts `/:id/revert`;
  - `http-dispatcher.ts:2238` `handlePackages`;
  - `domains/packages.ts:1882` revert branch;
  - `:1887` `metadataService.revertPackage(id)`;
  - `metadata-manager.ts:2062`, which collects members by `meta.packageId` / `meta.package` (`:2067`) and throws the 404 when there are none (`:2094`).
- **H2: confirmed, seam moved.** *Discard changes* is `POST /packages/:id/discard-drafts` (base `domains/packages.ts:1792`), which calls `protocol.discardPackageDrafts` (base `protocol.ts:23716`). That reads `SysMetadataRepository.listDrafts({ packageId })`, which filters `sys_metadata.package_id` for the caller's organization plus env-wide rows (base `sys-metadata-repository.ts:1220`, `:1259`). The read path decorates the same column as `_packageId`. That `where` is now `packageScopedRowWhere` (`sys-metadata-repository.ts:406`), used by `listDrafts` (`:1285`) for drafts and by the revert (`protocol.ts:23853`) for published rows. It is one statement of the rule. `MetadataManager.revertPackage` is reachable from the protocol (the `metadata` service), but the stored rows are not reachable from the manager. So the seam is the protocol.
- **H3: confirmed.** A stored item's published version is its `active` row, and a pending change is a separate `draft` row. `publish-drafts` promotes the draft (the drafts list empties). *Discard changes* removes the draft through `deleteMetaItem({ state: 'draft' })`, in the scope the draft lives in. The revert reuses that per-draft step, now shared as `discardDraftInItsScope` (`protocol.ts:23769`). There is no new revert mechanism. A package with stored rows but no active row answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`: "Package '…' has never been published, so there is no published version to revert to. Publish the package first, or discard its drafts to drop them."
- **H4: confirmed.** `com.example.showcase` is the code-shipped control. Its two capabilities carry an authored `packageId` (`examples/app-showcase/src/security/capabilities.ts`). It has no stored row, so `revertStoredPackage` answers `stored: false` and the unchanged metadata-service branch answers. It returned `409 "Package 'com.example.showcase' has never been published"` live at both base and head.

## Pins: base and head answers

| pin | base `b04a5295f7` | head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| (a) Studio package, published, one draft | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, draft stays | 200 `{ success: true }`, drafts `[]`, the published body serves |
| (b) Studio package, never published | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, worded, draft untouched |
| (c) unknown id | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (unchanged) |
| (d) code-shipped `com.example.showcase` | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` "has never been published" | the same 409, the same sentence |
| published Studio package, no draft | 404 | 200 |

The live door gave these answers on both boots. `packages/runtime/src/package-revert-stored-members.integration.test.ts` pins them at the door: a real `HttpDispatcher`, a real ObjectQL on better-sqlite3, the real protocol and a real `MetadataManager`. It has 9 cases. Two of them pin the organization rule: an org caller reverts the env-wide draft, and another organization's draft is not touched. `domains/packages-vetted-org-source.test.ts` adds the revert door to its roster, because the door now reads the caller's vetted organization. No door-level pin under `packages/qa/dogfood/test/` was needed.

## Reverse verification

On committed HEAD, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` was restored to base with `git restore --source=b04a5295f7 --worktree`. The anchor count dropped from 4 to 0, and the file's blob equalled the base blob. Predicted before the run: 6 red, 3 green. Measured: 6 red, 3 green. Every red was `expected 404 to be 200` or `expected 404 to be 409`, the base's 404. The three controls stayed green. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- …`. Proof: `git hash-object` equals the HEAD blob `2df234a954`, the index blob equals the same, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status` is clean.

## Clause-② (measured on the built entry declarations)

The claim declared `no`. The built `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `dist/index.d.ts`, base against head with comments stripped, gains one public method, `revertStoredPackage(request)`, and one `private` member. `packageScopedRowWhere` is not exported from the entry. The `@objectstack/runtime` `dist/index.d.ts` is byte-identical with comments stripped. One added public method on an exported class is a widening, as in the `declinesStoredRow` precedent. So the line above reads `yes (widening)`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` is graded `minor`, and `@objectstack/runtime` is graded `patch` with `Clause-②: no` in its changeset. The route's request and response contract is unchanged.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run`: 221 files passed, 3 skipped; 28227 tests passed, 19 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local`: 333 files passed; 4710 tests passed, 19 skipped.
- `typecheck` for both packages exits 0. The runtime test layer holds its ledger (27 files, 190 errors, 68 signatures, unchanged).
- The `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derivation at `723afed248` gives 65 commands, all run. `--ran` reconciles 65 of 65 with a derived zero NOT-MEASURED.
- The 53-row artifact-roster block was run too. 51 rows are green; `check-partof-closing-keyword` was run with this body as `PR_BODY`. `check-closing-target-claim` and `check-single-claim-paths` need a PR number, so CI reads them.
- `check-changeset-no-major` was run with this body as the event payload. Its level axis reads `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and finds `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` graded `minor`. It is green.

## Acceptance notes

- **An item created after the last publish is removed by the revert.** It is a draft with no published row, so it was not part of the published state. *Discard changes* removes it too. For a stored package the two buttons now do the same thing once the package has been published. The objectui wording follow-up triage foresaw (merge them, or keep both with distinct meanings) is unchanged.
- **Code-shipped package with an org overlay draft (boundary, unchanged answer class).** This was measured live with an org-scoped draft of `showcase_task.done` bound to `com.example.showcase`. The package now has a stored draft and no active stored row, so the revert answers `409` with the stored half's sentence. At base it answered `409` with the registry's sentence. The draft stays in both. Whether a code baseline counts as "published" belongs to the same Revert-versus-Discard follow-up.
- **A refused draft fails the call.** The error carries the refusal's own `code` and `status`. Drafts discarded before it stay discarded, as with `discard-drafts`. A collected list would have reached the door's `{ success: true }` as a success.
- **The door does not forward a body `actor`.** It read no body before, and its request contract is unchanged.
